build.defaultDescription: A software project developed through continuous iteration.
build.timelineIntro: A chronological selection of actually merged changes, GitHub releases and — where verified — a public project page. Every entry links to its source.
build.note_feature: Merged into the source repository; this does not establish production deployment.
build.note_fix: A correction merged into source; production impact is not asserted here.
build.note_change: Merged source-code change; production results are not inferred.
build.note_release: Officially published on GitHub Releases; deployment is not assumed.
build.note_origin: Date the GitHub repository was created, not the verified date of the first prototype.
build.note_public_page: Public page checked on the recorded case-study date; not necessarily a functional demo.
build.empty: No qualifying public events are available for this project.
build.incomplete: Not all GitHub API requests succeeded; this timeline may be incomplete.
build.limitations: A selective history: GitHub provides repository, merge and release dates. Additional product milestones are source-linked maintainer statements, not independent certification. Shipping, deployment and user adoption are never inferred from code activity.
build.note_prototype: A repository-authored milestone backed by a GitHub source. A code date alone does not prove the prototype was usable.
build.note_demo: A self-reported milestone with a public source. Video or source code alone cannot certify a working user journey.
build.note_deployment: A deployment milestone reported by the maintainer and linked to public evidence. Green CI or a release does not prove a production system is operational.
